items.title: Add formal Loop Engineering claim evaluation without unlocking higher layers
items.context: Existing capability_claim_formal_evaluate is Layer-2-only. Implement a bounded Layer 3 formal evaluator/proof path that can authorize only loop-engineering from fresh Development, Engineering, and Loop Engineering suite proof, while keeping Production Safety and global claims locked.
items.userSees: User sees capability_claim_formal_evaluate --target loop-engineering produce a formal report surface with loopEngineeringClaim gated separately from Production Safety/global claims.

happy.desc: A valid fresh loop-engineering proof root returns loopEngineeringClaim=UNLOCKED while productionSafetyClaim and globalCapabilityClaim remain LOCKED.

edge.desc: A valid Layer 2 engineering target still evaluates through the existing Layer 2 path without behavior regression.

adversarial.desc: A loop-engineering evaluator run with missing or stale lower-layer proof returns LOCKED/BLOCKED and does not unlock higher claims.

verificationEvidence.note: Layer 2 engineering target remains authorized independently and loopEngineeringClaim stays LOCKED for the engineering-only target.
Smoke covers missing/forged loop proof and higher-layer target fail-closed behavior.

items.title: Make UDM baseline formal reports mechanically valid and fail-closed
items.context: The 10 UDM baselines already exist as definitions. Ensure formal run/suite validation accepts the documented UDM evidence contract only when required refs, stop conditions, budget/review/host evidence, freshness, and false-DONE constraints are satisfied.
items.userSees: User sees malformed or incomplete UDM final reports rejected with machine-readable blocking reasons instead of being counted as formal proof.

happy.desc: All 10 documented UDM final reports with required refs, host verdicts, stop/budget/gate evidence, falseDone=false, and authority production flags false aggregate into a loop-engineering suite PASS.

edge.desc: Expected-block UDM baselines are accepted only when their outcome matches expectedOutcome and include gate/stop evidence rather than normal PASS.

adversarial.desc: A UDM report missing required refs, using localOnly proof, setting falseDone=true, or setting productionDone/fullAuthorityDone=true is rejected fail-closed.

items.title: Execute fresh Layer 3 UDM suite after final Layer 1/2 proof refresh
items.context: Generate 10 UDM final reports under .lattice/artifacts/baseline/layer3-loop-engineering-unlock, aggregate loop-engineering suite, and confirm expected PASS/EXPECTED_BLOCK outcomes. After this story changes the formal evaluator or proof writer, refresh or re-pin Layer 1 and Layer 2 proof against the final selected HEAD/materialHash before consuming it. If lower-layer proof is stale or mismatched, Layer 3 formal execution must remain LOCKED instead of consuming old proof. Do not use .omx.
items.userSees: User sees a fresh .lattice Layer 3 artifact root containing refreshed Development, Engineering, and Loop Engineering suite reports bound to the final HEAD/materialHash.

happy.desc: The final Layer 3 root contains 6 Development, 9 Engineering, and 10 UDM formal reports plus suite reports all bound to the selected final headHash/materialHash.

edge.desc: Layer 3 execution refuses to consume the older Layer 1/2 proof root when headHash/materialHash does not match the final story target.

adversarial.desc: No formal Layer 3 proof artifact is written under .omx or accepted from .omx as a Lattice proof root.

items.title: Verify claim boundaries and two-host review evidence
items.context: Run formal claim evaluation so loopEngineeringClaim becomes UNLOCKED, while productionSafetyClaim and globalCapabilityClaim remain LOCKED. Capture Codex and Claude CLI independent review artifacts as non-authority host evidence.
items.userSees: User sees two independent host review artifacts, one Claude CLI and one Codex CLI, referenced as non-authority evidence in the Layer 3 delivery report.

happy.desc: Claude CLI and Codex CLI review artifacts are captured with distinct host identities, current headHash/materialHash binding, and PASS verdicts for Layer 3 boundary behavior.

edge.desc: Host verdict refs are accepted only as review evidence and do not satisfy Authority production receipt fields.

adversarial.desc: Duplicate host identity, stale host verdict, or single-host self-certification blocks the loop-engineering claim.

items.title: Run regression, smoke, and lifecycle validation
items.context: Run targeted baseline smoke/fail-closed tests, project validation, convergence check, and complete the story through REVIEW/TEST/DONE with current evidence.
items.userSees: User sees build, targeted smoke, validation, and final lifecycle checks pass, followed by a summary that Layer 3 is unlocked and higher layers remain locked.

happy.desc: npm build, lattice baseline smoke, and story validation pass with verificationEvidence tied to current HEAD/materialHash.

edge.desc: Existing Layer 2 formal evaluator smoke tests still pass after adding the Layer 3 path.

adversarial.desc: Regression tests prove stale lower-layer proof, missing review evidence, and higher-layer overclaim remain locked or blocked.

auditLog.reason: Begin bounded Layer 3 formal evaluator implementation.
